context:
Commit .todo-db/config.json binding the hosted database, and narrow the
.gitignore rule so the config is tracked while the databases and replica stay
ignored. Make an unselected backend a hard error for every mutating subcommand
rather than a warning, so a write can never land in the wrong database. Keep the
local path available for tests via an explicit flag or env var.
description:
Running `_project/scripts/todo` with no TODO_DB_URL selects a local fallback at
.todo-db/todo.sqlite. `doctor` warns, but every other subcommand proceeds. That
local database sits at schema v3 while the CLI expects v5, so commands fail with
'database schema_version=3, CLI expects 5; run `todo migrate`'.

The failure mode is the dangerous part: the message points at a migration, which
invites an operator to run `todo migrate` -- or worse `todo init` -- against a
database that is NOT the tracker. On 2026-07-29 and 2026-07-31 this presented as
'the tracker is down' and two findings were written to out-of-tree drafts
instead of being filed. The hosted tracker was healthy the whole time (v5, 2045
items).

Contributing cause: .gitignore line 196 has a bare `.todo-db/` rule, which is
exactly what the todo-db bootstrap guide warns against because it hides the
committed .todo-db/config.json that would otherwise bind the hosted backend. No
config.json exists in this repo, so every session must supply TODO_DB_URL by hand.

anti_patterns.dont: commit a token or a DSN containing credentials into config.json
anti_patterns.instead: commit the URL only; mint tokens inline per session with an expiration
anti_patterns.why: the repo is public and _project/todo-db-export/ is committed

anti_patterns.dont: keep the bare `.todo-db/` gitignore rule and work around it with a symlink or an env var in a dotfile
anti_patterns.instead: narrow the ignore rule to the databases and replica, and track config.json
anti_patterns.why: it hides the committed config the tool is designed to discover, which is the root cause of the manual binding every session

anti_patterns.dont: leave the local fallback as a warning for mutating subcommands
anti_patterns.instead: hard-error unless a backend was selected explicitly
anti_patterns.why: a warning on stderr during a batch run is invisible and the write lands in the wrong database

anti_patterns.dont: run `todo migrate` or `todo init` against the hosted tracker to resolve a schema message
anti_patterns.instead: select the hosted backend explicitly and confirm with doctor first
anti_patterns.why: the schema mismatch is on the local fallback; a guess-based migration against the production tracker risks 2045 live items

preserves.behavior: Backend selection precedence is unchanged: explicit flag, then TODO_DB_PATH, then TODO_DB_URL, then discovered config.
Credentials are never stored in the repo or echoed: config.json carries the database URL only, tokens stay in the environment and are minted per session.
Local file databases remain usable for tests via an explicit --db or TODO_DB_PATH.
The committed _project/todo-db-export/ contract is unchanged; tracker item text remains public, so no secrets in item prose.

prior_art.concept: records the verified hosted round-trip and the inline token-minting procedure; also records the open provisioning item this change closes
thin wrapper already pins TODO_SCHEMA_VERSION for the merge gate; backend binding belongs in the committed config, not in wrapper flags
documents the backend selection precedence (--db, then TODO_DB_PATH, then TODO_DB_URL, then default local) and the never-echo credential rule; the fix must keep that precedence

verifications.description: The committed tracker config exists and is not git-ignored
verifications.expected: exit 0; config.json is tracked while databases and replica stay ignored

verifications.command: uv run python -c "import json;d=json.load(open('.todo-db/config.json'));s=json.dumps(d).lower();assert 'token' not in s and 'eyj' not in s"
verifications.description: The committed config contains no credential material
The local databases and replica remain git-ignored

File the two out-of-tree finding drafts into the tracker and remove them
